title: Programiz: Disarium Number Checker
description: A number is called Disarium if sum of its digits powered with their respective positions equals the number itself (e.g. 175 is a Disarium number as 1^1 + 7^2 + 5^3 = 1 + 49 + 125 = 175). Return `True` if disarium, else `False`.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^9
• Time: O(log N) | Space: O(log N)
explanation: Evaluates sum of digits powered by 1-based index in O(log N) time.
